articles.title: Fire use by ancient humans just got a whole lot older
articles.summary: Burnt bones in South Africa's Wonderwerk Cave suggest Homo erectus used fire up to 1.8 million years ago—almost double the previous record. Scientists used a forensic technique to spot the evidence.

articles.title: Ticklishness is no joke: scientists map the body's giggle zones
articles.summary: A new study surveyed 448 adults from three cultures and found ticklish spots are remarkably similar—neck, armpits, belly, feet. The research even connects tickling to our ape relatives.

articles.title: A new compound burns fat without the muscle loss of popular weight-loss drugs
articles.summary: UC Berkeley scientists found that TOFA helps obese mice lose fat while keeping muscle, unlike GLP-1 drugs. It works by boosting energy use, and combining it with Ozempic worked even better.
